25835-the-branding-iron.title: The Branding Iron
25835-the-branding-iron.creator: Katharine Newlin Burt
25835-the-branding-iron.description: A book by Katharine Newlin Burt. so searching as the night silence of a wild country buried five feet deep in snow. For thirty miles or so, north, south, east, and west of the small, half-smothered speck of gold in Pierre Landis's cabin window, there lay, on a certain December night, this silence, bathed in moonlight.

arxiv-2004-05164.title: Fast and effective techniques for T-count reduction via spider nest identities
arxiv-2004-05164.creator: Niel de Beaudrap, Xiaoning Bian, Quanlong Wang
arxiv-2004-05164.description: Abstract In fault-tolerant quantum computing systems, realising (approximately) universal quantum computation is usually described in terms of realising Clifford+T operations, which is to say a circuit of CNOT, Hadamard, and π / 2 {\pi\!\!\>/2} -phase rotations, together with T T operations ( π / 4 {\pi\!\!\>/4} -phase rotations).

arxiv-2109-11675.title: Removing the deadwood from DFT/MRCI wave functions: The p-DFT/MRCI method
arxiv-2109-11675.creator: Simon P. Neville, Michael S. Schuurman
arxiv-2109-11675.description: Abstract The combined density functional theory and multireference configuration interaction (DFT/MRCI) method is a powerful tool for the calculation of excited electronic states of large molecules. There exists, however, a large amount of superfluous configurations in a typical DFT/MRCI wave function.

arxiv-2207-01129.title: A Gray Code of Ordered Trees
arxiv-2207-01129.creator: Shin-ichi Nakano
arxiv-2207-01129.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shin-ichi Nakano. Abstract A combinatorial Gray code for a set of combinatorial objects is a sequence of all combinatorial objects in the set so that each object is derived from the preceding object by changing a small part. In this paper we design a Gray code for ordered trees with n vertices such that each ordered tree is derived from the preceding ordered tree by removing a leaf then appending a leaf elsewhere.

arxiv-2210-16617.title: Spectral properties of an acoustic-elastic transmission eigenvalue problem with applications
arxiv-2210-16617.creator: Huaian Diao, Hongjie Li, Hongyu Liu, Jiexin Tang
arxiv-2210-16617.description: Abstract . We are concerned with a coupled-physics spectral problem arising in the coupled propagation of acoustic and elastic waves, which is referred to as the acoustic-elastic transmission eigenvalue problem. There are two major contributions in this work which are new to the literature.

arxiv-2409-13870.title: Instruction-Tuning Pretrained Causal Language Models for Text Restoration of Ancient Greek Papyri and Inscriptions
arxiv-2409-13870.creator: Eric Cullhed
arxiv-2409-13870.description: Abstract This article presents an experiment in fine-tuning a pretrained causal language model (Meta’s Llama 3.1 8B Instruct) to assist with restoring missing or illegible characters in ancient Greek inscriptions and documentary papyri. Utilizing a straightforward instruction-based approach and a 95%/5% train/test split, the papyrus restoration model achieved a character error rate (CER) of 14.9%, a top-1 accuracy of 73.

arxiv-2410-02827.title: Effective Intrusion Detection for UAV Communications using Autoencoder-based Feature Extraction and Machine Learning Approach
arxiv-2410-02827.creator: Tuan-Cuong Vuong, Cong Chi Nguyen, Van-Cuong Pham, Thi-Thanh-Huyen Le, Xuan-Nam Tran, and Thien Van Luong
arxiv-2410-02827.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tuan-Cuong Vuong, Cong Chi Nguyen, Van-Cuong Pham, Thi-Thanh-Huyen Le, Xuan-Nam Tran, and Thien Van Luong. This paper proposes a novel intrusion detection method for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) in the presence of recent actual UAV intrusion dataset. In particular, in the first stage of our method, we design an autoencoder architecture for effectively extracting important features, which are then fed into various machine learning models in the second stage for detecting and classifying attack types.

arxiv-2508-16415.title: Dimension and topology in transserial tame pairs
arxiv-2508-16415.creator: Nigel Pynn-Coates
arxiv-2508-16415.description: Abstract . Every maximal Hardy field has a proper elementary differential subfield that is Dedekind complete in the maximal Hardy field. This pair of Hardy fields is a transserial tame pair, shown to have a complete and model complete elementary theory in [ Pyn24 ] .

pmc-11410813.title: Prevalence and determinants of occupational depression, anxiety, and stress among Ethiopian healthcare workers
pmc-11410813.creator: Yitagesu Habtu, Abera Kumie, Medhine Selamu, Hidenori Harada, Eshetu Girma
pmc-11410813.description: Studies on the prevalence and factors of depression, and anxiety symptoms from a work-ascribed or causal perspective are not available and studies on the prevalence of occupational stress in Ethiopia are limited. Therefore, this study aimed to determine the prevalence of occupational depression, job anxiety, and occupational stress, and to identify their determinants in healthcare workers.

pmc-12787693.title: Zn–IMP 3D Coordination Polymers for Drug Delivery: Crystal Structure and Computational Studies †
pmc-12787693.creator: Hafiz Zeshan Aqil, Yanhong Zhu, Masooma Hyder Khan, Yaqoot Khan, Beenish Sandhu, Muhammad Irfan, Hui Li
pmc-12787693.description: Coordination polymers (CPs) are garnering attention in the field of medicine day by day. The goal is to develop a CP with biosafe and environment-friendly characteristics. Herein, we report two such novel 3D coordination polymers of zinc-inosine-5′-monophosphate (Zn-IMP) and bpe/azpy (as linkers) which were engineered as metal–organic frameworks that can be used as drug carriers for hydroxyurea (HU).

pmc-13072514.title: Prevalence and determinants of anemia in hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Northwest Ethiopia
pmc-13072514.creator: Befikad Mandefro, Bedasa Addisu, Amanuel Kelem, Tiruneh Adane
pmc-13072514.description: BackgroundThyroid hormones are essential for metabolic control and red blood cell production. Imbalances in these hormones can cause anemia by disrupting erythropoiesis. Low thyroid hormone levels in hypothyroidism impair red blood cell production by inhibiting erythroid progenitor activity and erythropoietin (EPO) synthesis.

pmc-13121805.title: Thermal detection of single photons using Dirac fermions
pmc-13121805.creator: Bevin Huang, Ethan G Arnault, Woochan Jung, Caleb Fried, B Jordan Russell, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Erik A Henriksen, Dirk Englund, Gil-Ho Lee, Kin Chung Fong
pmc-13121805.description: Detecting single photons is a crucial process in quantum science, quantum networking, biology, and advanced imaging. To detect the small quantum of energy carried in a photon, conventional mechanisms rely on energy excitation across either a semiconductor bandgap or superconducting gap that hinders their applications to low-energy photons.

uslaw-usc-t22-s4071k.title: 22 U.S.C. § 4071k — Spousal agreements
uslaw-usc-t22-s4071k.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s4071k.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 52 (Foreign Service); Subchapter VIII (Foreign Service Retirement And Disability); Part II (Foreign Service Pension System). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A spousal agreement is any written agreement (properly authenticated as determined by the Secretary of State) between a participant or former participant and his or her spouse or former spouse on.
